fact: Ethiopia, with UNDP and Addis Ababa University, has established an AI University Innovation Pod equipped with laboratories, robotics facilities and high-performance computing systems, per Birr Metrics.

Ethiopia's 2026/27 federal budget proclamation, per the Ministry of Finance workbook, appropriates ETB 162,080,000 from the Treasury to the Artificial Intelligence Institution for National Artificial Intelligence Datacenter Deployment and ETB 170,000,000 for a National Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory.

The Ministry of Finance's 2025/26 budget workbook lists a capital project, National Artificial Intelligence Datacenter Deployment, of ETB 50,000,000 under the Artificial Intelligence Institution, and a National Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory of ETB 152,649,000, among its EFY 2017 capital projects.

The Ministry of Finance's 2024/25 budget record gives the Artificial Intelligence Institution capital projects including a National Artificial Intelligence Datacenter Deployment (ETB 50,000,000), a Computational Center for IOT Project Expansion (ETB 61,672,000) and a National Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory (ETB 152,649,000).
Addis Fortune reports the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute developed automatic court transcription software with the Federal Supreme Court, delivered for 15.8 million Br.
